On a gray March morning, a green bottle lay wedged between two rocks, its cork sealed with wax. Inside was a single page, the ink blurred but readable. 'To whoever tends the light: I watched your beam from a drifting boat thirty years ago, and it brought me home. I never thanked you. Thank you.' Tomas read it twice, then climbed the spiral stairs and sat beside the great lamp. He had never imagined anyone saw it as more than a warning. That night he polished the lens until it shone brighter than ever.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。路灯在湿漉漉的街面上投下一圈圈昏黄的光，偶尔有一辆洒水车缓缓驶过，留下哗哗的水声。便利店的灯还亮着，店员趴在柜台上打盹。远处的高楼只剩零星几扇窗透出光亮，像是不肯睡去的眼睛。早点铺的老板已经开始和面，蒸笼里冒出第一缕白气。清洁工拖着扫帚走过空荡的十字路口，红绿灯独自变换着颜色。风里带着一点凉意，天边还没有亮，新的一天已经悄悄开始了。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job.\n- Think of nesting dolls: you open one doll and find a smaller doll, and you keep opening until you reach the tiniest one.\n- The tiniest doll tells you when to stop, and then you put everything back together on the way out."}
